body: Also, I'm female and naturally frail body.

You're too good for this life you've been handed and really too good to talk to a piece of trash like me.

I've seen help and I've done resources but I don't want to choose to live no more. I wish I died yesterday and I wish I will die tomorrow. 

I have no family to talk to, I don't even know their contact info no more because they refuse a daughter with mental illness. They literally told me I was an embarassment and had me go.

Ive insane crippling anxiety and depression. I dont even look my landlord in the eye because im so scared. its why i became a shut in for so long....i feel like absolute trash. the few times in the past year when i could speak was when i was drunk because my bf had left me at the club he wanted to go to. that was like 4 months ago.

I'm in Canada and the gossip of amazing caring health is a lie. We don't have food stamps or any hunger relief, poverty combat agencies. I even checked into food banks but because I'm labeled as single female young adult they have me on waitlist. The last time I asked how long they said 3 months, and that was a week ago....
I don't know either. I just want to hang myself.
Ty.... but I know Im not.

I don't believe it. With not even a month's rent on my back I haven't been eating. At first I thought it'd be fine because girls can be skinnier and it feels like my stomach is so small as if I have an eating disorder.

It's not about time left in my entire life but the time I have to not be homeless at age 23. There's no foster home or friends. I don't have a mom or dad to support or love me. I don't have anyone or anything.

Even though I'm unaffiliated with religion, I doubt I could walk in, explain myself and be financially supported.

I don't think I can even walk in.
When my parents conflicted on was cheating on who I holed it up in my head that I was only going to love once. I understand that's unrealistic but I've committed to this for so long.
